identity_notes: This retrieval was dominated by records where 'lysine' refers to something other than the free amino-acid supplement: (a) lysine SALT forms of unrelated drugs (ibuprofen lysine/lysinate, aspirin/acetylsalicylate lysine, ketoprofen lysine, aztreonam lysine, lisdexamfetamine, lysine-MDMA) where lysine is only a salt-forming counterion, rejected as different_substance; (b) 'lysine' as a HISTONE RESIDUE in epigenetics research (H3K4, H3K9, H3K27, H3K56 methylation/acetylation, LSD1/KDM1A, SETD7, EZH2/EHMT2/G9a) -- a completely different biological meaning, all rejected off_topic; (c) advanced glycation end products (AGEs, e.g., N-carboxymethyl-lysine) as disease BIOMARKERS, which are lysine-derived but not lysine supplementation, rejected not_intervention/off_topic; and (d) lysine-based surgical tissue adhesives (TissuGlu) and antimicrobial catheter coatings (poly-L-lysine), medical devices not supplements. After removing these, only 16 genuine oral L-lysine human studies remained. The two foundational herpes simplex trials directly conflict: an early trial found L-lysine 1000mg TID reduced HSV recurrences (3115841, positive), while a later crossover trial at the same 1000mg daily dose found no effect on overall recurrence rate, though more patients were recurrence-free during lysine periods (6153847, null) -- both should be weighed together, not cherry-picked. Two dedicated safety systematic reviews exist (30661148, 33000161) and substantially overlap; both note limited safety data and no established upper intake limit historically, addressed by a more recent growth-focused safety review (38740261, 'Promises and precautions'). Several kept records combine lysine with arginine (8315224, 17510493), inositol/B12 (37245296), or zinc/vitamin C in a branded product (Lysulin, 32795739), so lysine's isolated contribution cannot be determined from those records. Multiple otherwise-relevant abstracts were truncated before the results sentence in this scope; the curator should re-pull full text before drawing efficacy conclusions.
